\sketch ↗ lem:chow-ii-main-factorial-curvature-estimate Iteration produces only $ abla ^i\Rm * abla ^{k-i}\Rm $; moving-metric and connection terms are absorbed into $ abla _t$. The same Pascal estimates and weighted $A_k,B_k$ argument apply with reduced coefficients. Thus only $C_n$, not the factorial order or conclusion, changes.
